text: I like the app, and I think it is one of the better ones out there. I just wish that this company specifically would be more reasonable with pricing. That would be a game changer, and frankly, I think they'd get a ton more business. I don't remember, but I think it's like $15 a month. It is not on my radar for "worth it" at that price. You know, $7–$8 max for any of these voice-dictating apps is about where they should go. Frankly, at $5 a month, I think they'll dominate this market entirely.
